items.t: Engine knocking or sudden engine failure (rod bearings)
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $6,000 for a full replacement; one owner paid $2,000 after Hyundai covered most of it.

items.t: Timing chain or cam timing faults (P0014, P0017)
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides, tensioner and CVVT units
items.note: If the chain jumped and bent valves, head work can push the bill to several thousand dollars.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides, tensioners and cam phasers
items.note: Reported quotes run about $1,500-$2,000 at independent shops and around $3,600 at a dealer.

items.t: Misfires and rough idle from intake valve carbon
items.job: Walnut-blast intake valve cleaning
items.note: Reported price is about $300-$500.

items.t: Unstable idle or stalling from a dirty throttle body
items.job: Clean or replace throttle body
items.note: Cleaning is often enough; owners report about $95 for a cleaning.

items.t: Turbo loses boost or wastegate actuator breaks
items.job: Replace turbocharger or wastegate actuator / boost control valve
items.note: A boost control solenoid alone costs far less than a turbo. Broken manifold studs add labor.

items.t: Oil leak from the turbo oil feed line
items.job: Replace turbo oil feed line
items.note: One owner paid about $58 for an aftermarket line.

items.t: Engine revs hang between gear shifts
items.job: Engine computer software update

items.t: Manual transmission grinds between gears
items.job: Gear oil change, or synchro repair / transmission replacement
items.note: A fluid change costs about $50-$85; synchro repair or a replacement transmission costs much more.

items.t: Clutch pedal soft or sticking from master or slave cylinder
items.job: Replace clutch master and/or slave cylinder and bleed
items.note: The slave cylinder sits inside the bellhousing on some versions, which adds labor. One owner paid $1,500 for both.

items.t: Clutch slipping or worn out
items.job: Replace clutch, flywheel and release bearing
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $3,400-$3,700 at a dealer; independent shops quote less.

items.t: Automatic shifter stuck or frozen in cold weather
items.job: Replace shift cable end boot (service campaign)
items.note: Done free under Hyundai's campaign if not already completed.

items.t: Automatic transmission harsh shifts or failure
items.job: Transmission software update, or replace transmission
items.note: A software update is cheap; owners report up to $9,000 for a new transmission.

items.t: Oil leaks from the V6 oil filter housing, timing cover or sensor
items.job: Replace leaking gasket, seal, housing or sensor
items.note: An oil pressure sensor ran about $300; a timing cover reseal about C$1,000.

items.t: Thermostat failure on the turbo engine
items.job: Replace thermostat and refill coolant

items.t: Coolant leaks and overheating on the V6
items.job: Replace water pump or thermostat housing

items.t: A/C blows warm from compressor or condenser failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor or condenser and recharge
items.note: Owners report $210 for a condenser and $850-$1,483 for a compressor.

items.t: Keyless entry door handle button stops working
items.job: Replace outside door handle with proximity sensor
items.note: One owner paid $379.

items.t: Brake lights and push-button start fail from brake switch (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor connector can come loose (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Rear differential bolts can loosen on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: ABS module can leak and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Car can move if started in gear (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Driver airbag bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Hyundai dealer

items.t: Water leaks into the tail lights
items.job: Reseal or replace tail light housing
items.note: One owner paid about C$50 for new seals.

items.t: Weak battery or slow cranking
items.job: Replace 12V battery
items.note: Owners report about $105-$120.

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensors
items.job: Replace oxygen sensor
items.note: Owners report $72 for one sensor (DIY) up to about $530 for two.

items.t: Whining from the serpentine belt idler pulley
items.job: Replace idler and tensioner pulleys
items.note: The part alone ran about $39.

items.t: Engine vibration from worn motor mounts
items.job: Replace engine mounts
items.note: One owner paid about C$900 for two mounts.

items.t: Radio, navigation or Bluetooth failures
items.job: Software update or replace head unit
items.note: One owner was quoted $3,416 for a new unit; updates are much cheaper.
